policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agreements a
  WHERE ((a.id = agreement_messages.agreement_id) AND ((a.requester_account_id = auth.uid()) OR (a.worker_account_id = auth.uid())))))

broadcast_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER tr_check_filters BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON realtime.subscription FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION realtime.subscription_check_filters()
CREATE TRIGGER pre_v3_safety_message BEFORE INSERT ON public.agreement_messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.safety_guard_interaction_write()
CREATE TRIGGER pre_v3_closure_message BEFORE INSERT ON public.agreement_messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.closure_guard_owned_write('AGREEMENT', 'agreement_id')
CREATE TRIGGER agreement_photo_message_guard_v5 BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.agreement_messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.agreement_photo_message_guard_v5()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER agreement_photo_link_guard_v5 AFTER INSERT ON public.agreement_messages DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.agreement_photo_link_guard_v5()

relevant_helpers.body: begin if auth.uid() is null then return false;end if;perform private.closure_assert_open(auth.uid());return true;end;
